messages:
maya (design): quick UX check — when you apply filters and there are no rules, the panel shows 'No rules matched' and a tiny icon. feels cold and a bit confusing. can we make it more helpful? arjun (product): yes. current copy is terse. propose: 'No routing rules match your filters. Clear filters or create a rule to start routing.' CTA: primary 'Create rule', secondary text link 'Reset filters'. samir (frontend): implementation note — the virtual list collapses then expands when placeholder appears, causes layout jump. i can keep a fixed min-height to avoid the jump. also we should avoid large images in empty state for perf. elaine (a11y): a11y concerns: screen reader users need context — announce count + active filters. suggestion: - add a polite live region for counts: "0 rules match. filters: service=payments, status=enabled" - for error states (e.g., reorder failed) use assertive live region - ensure CTAs are keyboard focusable and have descriptive accessible names maya (design): agree. microcopy tweak: short line then secondary explanation. e.g., "No routing rules match your current filters." "Clear filters or create a new rule to see routing previews." arjun (product): also flag: preview panel currently dims to ~30% opacity when no snapshot is selected. users in usability test thought panel was broken. i'd rather show a small overlay box with headline 'Preview unavailable' + short reason + actionable link/button. samir (frontend): good call. plan: overlay with subtle card centered inside preview area: title, one-line reason, primary action 'Select snapshot' and a link 'Create a snapshot'. overlay will be focus-trapped when opened via keyboard. when snapshot fetch is pending show spinner instead. example markup:

Preview unavailable

No model snapshot is selected for this policy.

Select snapshot
for the counts:
0 rules match your filters
for errors:
Failed to reorder rule. Undo?
elaine (a11y): small nit: use "role=status" for non-critical updates and ensure we don't spam it on every keystroke. for reorders/errors, include an actionable undo button and make the toast focusable so SRs read it. persistent until dismissed is preferred for errors. maya (design): another tiny copy thing — reorder handle helper. currently hidden. propose a one-line hint under handle: 'Drag to change priority — changes are saved automatically.' keep it only visible on hover/focus for visual clarity but present to SR always. arjun (product): decision summary: - replace dead 'No rules matched' with actionable copy + CTA - add preview overlay when no snapshot or when disabled rather than dim-only - keep list min-height to avoid jump (samir) - live regions: polite for counts, assertive for errors; make error toast persistent and focusable - add helper microcopy for reorder handles visible on hover/focus owners: maya copy + design, samir frontend + PR, elaine will review a11y. i'll update the spec doc after this thread. samir (frontend): starting work — will keep animations subtle. opening PR when ready (will reference staging job). ETA EOD tomorrow. redwood-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for staging at 2025-06-01 22:00 UTC :rocket: maya (design): thanks — i'll mock the empty state card and the overlay tonight, will attach screenshots in the product doc. arjun (product): perfect. will review in design critique tomorrow. :+1: elaine (a11y): i'll prepare a short checklist for the PR: focus order, aria labels, live region tests with NVDA + VoiceOver, keyboard-only flows. samir (frontend): note — i'll include a small test case in storybook for the empty-state and overlay. PR will include test notes. arjun (product): ok team — action items assigned. tagging this for follow-up in the design doc and the sprint board.
